entities.name: Viorel Ștefan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viorel Ștefan is a Romanian politician and economist who served as a Member of the European Court of Auditors for Romania from 2019 to 2025. He previously served as Deputy Prime Minister of Romania from 2018 to 2019 and as Minister of Public Finance from January to June 2017.

entities.summary: Viorel Ștefan is a Romanian politician and economist who served as a Member of the European Court of Auditors for Romania from 2019 to 2025. He previously served as Deputy Prime Minister of Romania from 2018 to 2019 and as Minister of Public Finance from January to June 2017.
